kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أعتقل (form VIII)
# أَعْتَقِلُ (ʔaʕtaqilu) /ʔaʕ.ta.qi.lu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِعْتَقَلَ (iʕtaqala)
# أُعْتَقَلُ (ʔuʕtaqalu) /ʔuʕ.ta.qa.lu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِعْتَقَلَ (iʕtaqala)
# أَعْتَقِلَ (ʔaʕtaqila) /ʔaʕ.ta.qi.la/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِعْتَقَلَ (iʕtaqala)
# أُعْتَقَلَ (ʔuʕtaqala) /ʔuʕ.ta.qa
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
